title: The llama name points to Llama 4 Scout
summary:
The `llama` name switched to Llama 4 Scout, while token-authenticated requests got more queue room outside the seed tier.

The `llama` text-model name now aliases Llama 4 Scout 17B instead of the separate Llama 3.3 70B model. Requests using that name will target a different model.

The queue cap for token-authenticated, non-seed tiers rose from 3 to 20. Seed stays at 3, and Nectar bypasses the queue only when requests are token-authenticated.

`openai-roblox` was removed from the available text models.

daily.title: Llama points to Scout
daily.text: Use `llama` to request Llama 4 Scout 17B; the name previously pointed to a separate Llama 3.3 70B model. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=llama).
